steps: A fixed camera is reviewed in three languages at 390px; cancelling preserves all author bytes.

Explicit Save creates the reviewed fixed camera and both references; an invalid target is refused. An existing camera is then reviewed and saved as follow, changing only its source, and reopens with the same instance and parameters.

dialogs.message: 未保存のカメラ変更を破棄しますか？

limitations: Actual Chrome HTTP authoring in a disposable workspace; installed Tauri, Android, runtime camera frames and Bevy are not tested.
Creation persists three related files; editing persists only the camera source.
